subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for your recent job application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We appreciate the time and effort you put into your application. We are currently reviewing all applications and will be in touch with selected candidates for the next steps in the hiring process. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and wish you the best of luck in your job search. Sincerely, [Company Name]
